toegepas.blok: Siekte is meer as net die liggaam
toegepas.rede_vinder: The dummy 'dit' with a trailing 'wat nog' clause reads awkwardly and 'dit' can be misread as pointing back to 'siekte'; 'ander dinge wat' says the same thing plainly.
toegepas.fout: The anticipatory 'dit' with an extraposed 'wat nog' clause is stiff and makes a Grade 6 reader work to find the subject.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'tel ook ander dinge wat' says the same thing plainly, keeps the sense of 'something else besides physical causes', and leaves the protected 'In hierdie siening' intact.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: en party veral met die voorouers
laat_vaar_vorige.na: en party werk veral met die voorouers
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Repeating the verb gives the second clause its own verb, which reads more clearly and makes the AWS comma before 'en' fully justified.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The elided verb is natural Afrikaans and reads clearly, so repeating 'werk' is a lateral move.
